selection: Group all discovered UIDs before splitting. Rank groups and member UIDs by SHA256(seed|split-role|id), select 8 eligible official-test groups, 8 unexposed official-train validation groups, then 32 remaining official-train groups. One object per group. Never rank by model output.
geometry: No simplification, subdivision, remeshing, welding or topology repair. Reject nonfinite coordinates, nonpositive extent, invalid indices, duplicate unordered source triangles, or cross-product norm <= 1e-12 times squared raw bbox maximum extent. Strict global watertightness and self-intersection are not selection gates.

grouping.uid_family: Identical UID and identical trailing 16 hexadecimal UID characters are conservatively unioned; suffix is a heuristic, not verified provenance.
grouping.exact_geometry: All local Chair UIDs: exact float64 coordinate triangle multiset, invariant to face/corner order and vertex indexing; also bbox-centered max-extent normalized triangle multiset rounded to 6 decimals.
grouping.near_duplicate: All eligible-range valid objects plus historical development objects: symmetric normalized vertex-set Hausdorff <= 0.01 AND symmetric triangle-centroid Hausdorff <= 0.01, axis-aligned bbox normalization, cKDTree. Union matches conservatively. No rotation/reflection alignment, semantic ancestry or completeness claim. Record tested pair count and edges.
grouping.historical: Exclude discovered historically tuned/evaluated parent groups from validation and test; keep evidence paths. P0/P1 are regression only.

patches.seed_order: First source face maximizes squared centroid distance to object centroid mean (ties smallest source face ID); subsequently choose farthest point from previous attempted centroids (ties smallest source face ID). All source faces eventually attempted if required.
patches.growth: FIFO BFS over shared complete source-index edges, neighbors ascending source face ID, truncate at K; no welding or coordinate adjacency. Reject disconnected/too-small candidates.
patches.distinct: Require distinct start face, distinct source-face set and nonidentical start centroid. Record intersection/K and Jaccard overlap.
patches.interface: Any source edge crossing known/free must have exactly 2 incident faces, one known and one free; nonmanifold crossing rejects patch, not object. Require at least one valid interface edge. Save ascending source vertex IDs, adjacent raw source face IDs, and corner indices in stored full_target.

coordinates.implementation: datasets.mesh_dataset.ObjaverseDataset.__getitem__ via instance-local capture callbacks; same flags as native_t1.prepare, dynamic N; no noise draws or OT calls
coordinates.order: Rows restored to original source raw face IDs; corners keep official canonical order with explicit permutation to raw corners. C and free index the same once-preprocessed full object.

randomness.seed_derivation: first 8 bytes of SHA256(control_mvp48_v1|namespace|identity) interpreted little-endian modulo (2**32-1); independent namespace per purpose
randomness.numpy_rng: numpy.random.RandomState (MT19937); randn produces float64, cast to float32 only for model state after OT or at inference
randomness.training_order: Cycle 0..61: independently permute all 128 (UID,patch_id) pairs; final cycle take 64 from an independent permutation; chunk 8000 identities into 1000 effective batches of 8
randomness.training_permutations: One local RandomState(permutation_seed): free permutation, then N cyclic corner indices 0..2, then full N face permutation; applies to both known and free, and supervision mappings follow
randomness.plot_namespace: plot (reserved; no plotting RNG consumed during selection)
randomness.validation: 8 objects, patch p0, one namespace validation Gaussian seed, t=0.5; same cases at all three final endpoints = 24 teacher checks; no checkpoint selection
randomness.test: 8 objects * 2 patches * 2 Gaussian seeds = 32 cases, shared across three models = 96 outputs. Same object/noise index shares free Gaussian across its patches. Different N has no asserted coordinate correspondence.

freeze: Refuse identity mismatch and any existing frozen file differing in content. DATA_READY.json written atomically only after independent CPU audit passes; no GPU/model work.
